description_en: Queries the detail of a Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance
description_zh: 查询指定负载均衡实例的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun slb describe-load-balancer-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --load-balancer-id lb-bp1b6c719dfa08ex0000 --api-version 2014-05-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeLoadBalancerAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the CLB instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
传统型负载均衡实例的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html接口查询地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

Address.description_en: The service IP address of the CLB instance
Address.description_zh: 传统型负载均衡实例的服务地址。

AddressIPVersion.description_en: The version of the IP address. Valid values: ipv4 and ipv6

AddressType.description_en: The address type of the CLB instance
AddressType.description_zh: 传统型负载均衡实例的地址类型

AutoReleaseTime.description_en: The timestamp generated when the CLB instance is released

Bandwidth.description_en: The maximum bandwidth of the Internet-facing CLB instance that is billed on a pay-by-bandwidth basis
Bandwidth.description_zh: 按带宽计费的公网型实例的带宽峰值

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the CLB instance was created. The time is in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format
CreateTime.description_zh: 传统型负载均衡实例的创建时间。格式为：`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`

CreateTimeStamp.description_en: The timestamp generated when the CA certificate is uploaded
CreateTimeStamp.description_zh: 传统型负载均衡实例创建时间戳

DeleteProtection.description_en:
Indicates whether deletion protection is enabled for the CLB instance.

Valid values: on and off
DeleteProtection.description_zh:
是否开启实例删除保护。

取值：on或off

EndTime.description_en: The time when the CLB instance expires
EndTime.description_zh: 传统型负载均衡实例结束时间。

EndTimeStamp.description_en: The timestamp that indicates the expiration time of the CLB instance
EndTimeStamp.description_zh: 传统型负载均衡实例结束时间戳。

InstanceChargeType.description_zh:
实例计费方式。取值：

PayBySpec：按规格计费。
PayByCLCU：按使用量计费

InternetChargeType.description_en:
The metering method of the Internet-facing CLB instance. Valid values:

paybytraffic

paybybandwidth
InternetChargeType.description_zh:
公网类型实例付费方式。取值：

paybytraffic：按使用流量计费。
paybybandwidth：按固定带宽计费

LoadBalancerId.description_zh: 传统型负载均衡实例的ID

LoadBalancerName.description_en: The name of the CLB instance
LoadBalancerName.description_zh: 传统型负载均衡实例的名称

LoadBalancerSpec.description_en:
The specification of the CLB instance.

Pay-as-you-go CLB instances are not subject to specifications. By default, slb.lcu.elastic is returned
LoadBalancerSpec.description_zh:
传统型负载均衡实例的性能规格。
按使用量计费的实例无性能规格属性，默认返回 slb.lcu.elastic

LoadBalancerStatus.description_en:
The status of the CLB instance. Valid values:

inactive: The CLB instance is disabled. CLB instances in the inactive state do not forward traffic.

active: The CLB instance is running as expected. Newly created CLB instances are in the active state by default.

locked: The CLB instance is locked. CLB instances may be locked due to overdue payments or other reasons
LoadBalancerStatus.description_zh:
传统型负载均衡实例状态：

inactive：实例已停止，此状态的实例监听不会再转发流量。

active：实例运行中，实例创建后，默认状态为active。

locked：实例已锁定，实例已经欠费或被阿里云锁定

MasterZoneId.description_en: The ID of the primary zone to which the CLB instance belongs
MasterZoneId.description_zh: 传统型负载均衡实例的主可用区ID

ModificationProtectionReason.description_en:
The reason why the configuration read-only mode is enabled. The value is 1 to 80 characters in length. It starts with a letter and can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-).

This parameter is valid only when ModificationProtectionStatus is set to ConsoleProtection
ModificationProtectionReason.description_zh:
设置修改保护状态的原因，长度为1~80个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，支持数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。

仅在ModificationProtectionStatus为ConsoleProtection时有效

ModificationProtectionStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether the configuration read-only mode is enabled. Valid values:

NonProtection: The configuration read-only mode is disabled. After you disable the configuration read-only mode, the value of ModificationProtectionReason is cleared.

ConsoleProtection: The configuration read-only mode is enabled.

If this parameter is set to ConsoleProtection, you cannot modify instance configurations in the CLB console. However, you can modify instance configurations by calling API operations
ModificationProtectionStatus.description_zh:
传统型负载均衡修改保护状态：

NonProtection：不限制修改保护，设置后会清空之前设置的ModificationProtectionReason。
ConsoleProtection：实例控制台修改保护状态。

当取值为ConsoleProtection，即开启修改保护后，用户不能通过负载均衡控制台修改实例配置，但可以通过调用API修改实例配置

NetworkType.description_en: The network type of the CLB instance
NetworkType.description_zh: 传统型负载均衡实例的网络类型

PayType.description_en:
The billing method of the CLB instance. Valid values:

Only PayOnDemand may be returned, which indicates the pay-as-you-go billing method
PayType.description_zh:
传统型负载均衡实例付费类型。取值：

<props="china">- PrePay：包年包月。</props>

<props="china">- PayOnDemand（默认值）：按量付费。</props>

<props="intl">- PayOnDemand（默认值）：按量付费。</props>

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the CLB instance
RegionId.description_zh: 传统型负载均衡实例所在地域ID。

RegionIdAlias.description_en: The alias of the region to which the CLB instance belongs
RegionIdAlias.description_zh: 传统型负载均衡实例所属的地域别名

RenewalCycUnit.description_en:
The auto-renewal cycle. Valid values: Year and Month. Default value: Month.

This parameter is valid only if you create a subscription CLB instance on the Alibaba Cloud China site. In this case, PayType must be set to PrePay and RenewalStatus must be set to AutoRenewal
RenewalCycUnit.description_zh:
自动续费周期，取值：Year或Month（默认值）。

该参数仅适用于中国站包年包月实例，即PayType的参数值为PrePay且RenewalStatus为AutoRenewal时有效

RenewalDuration.description_en:
The auto-renewal duration. This parameter is valid only if RenewalStatus is set to AutoRenewal.

Valid values when PeriodUnit is set to Year: 1\~5.

Valid values when PeriodUnit is set to Month: 1\~ 9.

This parameter is valid only when you create a subscription CLB instance on the Alibaba Cloud China site. In this case, the PayType parameter must be set to PrePay
RenewalDuration.description_zh:
自动续费时长，仅在RenewalStatus为AutoRenewal时有效。

RenewalCycUnit为Year时，取值：1~5。
RenewalCycUnit为Month时，取值：1~9。

该参数仅适用于中国站包年包月实例，即PayType的参数值为PrePay时有效

RenewalStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether auto-renewal is enabled. Valid values:

AutoRenewal: Auto-renewal is enabled.

Normal: Auto-renewal is disabled. You must manually renew the CLB instance.

NotRenewal: The CLB instance will not be renewed upon expiration. If this value is returned, the system does not send notifications until three days before the expiration date.

  \

  Note This parameter is valid only when you create a subscription CLB instance on the Alibaba Cloud China site. In this case, PayType must be set to PrePay
RenewalStatus.description_zh:
续费状态，取值：

AutoRenewal：自动续费。
Normal：非自动续费，您需要自行续费负载均衡实例。
NotRenewal：不再续费。返回该值后，系统不再发送到期提醒，只在到期前第三天发送不续费提醒。

该参数仅适用于中国站包年包月实例，即PayType的参数值为PrePay时有效

SlaveZoneId.description_en: The ID of the secondary zone to which the CLB instance belongs
SlaveZoneId.description_zh: 传统型负载均衡实例的备可用区ID

VSwitchId.description_en: The ID of the vSwitch to which the internal-facing CLB instance belongs

VpcId.description_en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) where the internal-facing CLB instance is deployed
VpcId.description_zh: 传统型负载均衡私网实例的专有网络ID
